app.name: Geezy
app.long_description:
Real-time 3D video synthesizer and VJ instrument for Wii.
Supports sideways Wii Remote, dual Wii Remotes, Classic Controller, and class-compliant USB-MIDI pad controllers (Akai APC mini / MK2).
Features 5 selectable 3D worlds, 14 procedural sculpture families, 3 visual themes, 16 color palette banks, 8 momentary 2D graphic overlays, and hold-type master post-FX.
Controls (1 Wiimote sideways): - A (hold): Charge & strobe / release drop - B (hold): 2D graphic overlay (next pattern per press) - 1 / 2: New palette / new sculpture & motion - D-Pad: Impulse & boost steering (B + D-Pad: camera aim) - + / -: Speed gear - 2 + - / 2 + +: Cycle world / cycle theme - 1 + -: Cycle palette bank - 1 + +: Toggle HUD - 1 + 2: Full remix (1 + 2 + A/B: Freeze / Kaleidoscope) - + and -: Reset / HOME: Exit
No sensor bar required.
